_extraction_context.snippet_primary: "In August 2025, when Diego Gomez*, a Madrid-based Domestika instructor, checked his instructor dashboard, he found that the billion-dollar company had stopped paying him since July. He had stopped replying to comments four years ago (his contract never stated it as a payment condition), and he was still getting paid until June 2025."
